metadata.name: react-build-resolver
metadata.description: Diagnose and fix React build failures across Vite, webpack, Next.js, CRA, Parcel, esbuild, and Bun. Handles JSX/TSX compile errors, hydration mismatches, server/client component boundary failures, missing types, and bundler-specific configuration issues with minimal, surgical changes. MUST BE USED when a React build fails.
metadata.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
